source: Matrix kernels push this much further. ZXNAME0000XZ describes warpand thread-level ZXNAME0001XZ structures in which operands are loaded from shared memory into register-backed fragments and accumulators remain in registers across many matrix instructions.[14]
zh: 矩阵内核将这一点推得更远。 ZXNAME0000XZ 描述了 warpand 线程级 ZXNAME0001XZ 结构，其中操作数从共享内存加载到寄存器支持的片段中，并且累加器保留在许多矩阵指令的寄存器中。 [14]
